plan.notes: Source: Palomar College Program Pathways Mapper (official), Case Furniture Construction/Manufacturing Certificate of Achievement Program pathway map, https://programmap.palomar.edu/pathway/case-furniture-construction-manufacturing-to-career-2/?pt=map&year=2026, retrieved 2026-10-06. Palomar publishes the program total as a range (24 units); total_credits (24) is the exact sum of the minimum-unit pathway. All AA/AS/AA-T/AS-T degrees require 60 units per Palomar; maps represent one possible pathway — see a counselor for a personalized plan.
